_comment: Every upstream source the app's data comes from. `probe` is what the weekly probe does with it: 'change+stale' (report a new upstream version and a stale one), 'stale' (only report age; something else already refreshes it) or 'none' (not probed; recorded here for its licence and its fetch script). A new source is not accepted without a licence and an attribution (tests/test_probe_sources.py).

sources.name: BIS locational banking statistics
sources.licence: BIS terms of permitted use; only a small derived network is redistributed
sources.attribution: Bank for International Settlements, Locational Banking Statistics

sources.name: IMF CPIS (via the DBnomics mirror)
sources.licence: IMF data terms, retrieved through DBnomics' JSON mirror of the IMF SDMX API
sources.attribution: International Monetary Fund, Coordinated Portfolio Investment Survey

sources.name: FRED market data
sources.cadence: daily upstream; the app uses year-end values and rebuilds by hand
sources.licence: Varies per FRED series; check https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/ before redistributing. Not recorded in docs/data-api.md yet.
sources.attribution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, FRED
